title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Purpose** 




  





 You will be an experienced project manager with responsibilities for multiple and complex multi\\\\\\\\-stakeholder IT projects across functional areas and geographical boundaries, and with normally high budget and risk to the organisation.
 



  





 You will provide overall leadership to project teams and developers in the area of system and application development. You will be responsible for managing end\\\\\\\\-to\\\\\\\\-end project planning, scoping, cost and implementation. You will manage and execute project governance including progress reporting, and risk management to ensure the successful delivery of small and/or large scale IT projects.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Identify and act upon issues that affect the project delivery schedule, cost and scope or project risk. Will consult with project steering committee members or/and HKLT team.
 



  





**Project Management:** 




  




* Drive the successful delivery of large and/or complex multiple simultaneous IT projects and initiatives. Transition the delivery into business as usual (BAU).
* Work closely with business managers, internal and external developers, and IT team to ensure projects meet business requirements and goals, and are able to translate business ideas into workable solutions bringing clear benefits to the Business.
* Create and manages optimized project plans, critical success factors and key milestones for the large\\\\\\\\-scale projects.
* Executive appropriate project governance and controls to ensure projects are successfully delivered in best practice.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining standards of project planning, and all application and systems documentation, ensuring that plans and documentation are kept up to date at all times.
* Communicate and manage business expectations and to agree on project deliverables and service level.
* Overall operational responsibility for project teams; define, monitor and update the overall development plan, with particular emphasis on setting realistic deadlines and ensuring that they are met.
* Analyse project issues, costs, and benefits and make relevant recommendations to business and technology leadership team.
* Identify and analyse project risks and proactively responds to mitigate any circumstance that may jeopardize the project.
* Establish and manage relationship with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring that all parties are appropriately involved.
* Manage and contribute to the content of key project and programme deliverables e.g. business cases, requirements/functional/technical specifications.
* Ensure that projects/programmes are managed and controlled in accordance with agreed Bupa standards, methods and procedures
* Act as a role model in promoting and demonstrating best practice project management to the team and wider business.
* Effectively engages and manages IS vendors.



  





  





**Qualifications, Training and Experience** 




  




* University degree in Computer Science, IT or relevant disciplines.
* Recognised Project Management qualification (e.g. Prince2 Practitioner, PMP).
* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT in which at least 5 years of experience in project management (incl. planning, budgetary control, people management).
* Exposure in Healthcare/Insurance/Financial Institution projects will be a plus.



  





**Experience** 



* Strong track record of delivering IT projects on time and within budget, and able to interact with business partners, multiple teams.
* Experience of dealing at senior executive level and present project update to Senior Management and Boards.
* Experience in implementing best practice project management processes.



  





**Knowledge \\\\\\\\& Skills** 



* IT consulting/project management and people management skills.
* Expert knowledge of business and IT project delivery methodologies (e.g. Agile, SDLC).
* Strong leadership skills and demonstrable evidence of success in leading large project teams.
* Stakeholder management skills across a wide range of different stakeholders.
* Proficient in all project/ programme management areas and processes.
* Good presentation and communication skill.
* Fluent in English and Cantonese



  





 Bupa offers 5 days’ work per week and comprehensive remuneration packages including base salary, study assistance plan, company pension plan, life and medical benefit, dental benefit, annual leave, examination leave, etc.
 



 Bupa is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from qualified candidates. Information provided will be treated in strict confidence and only be used for consideration of application with Bupa.
 



  





 Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only. Bupa will be in touch for any opportunities that matches your profile. All personal data of unsuccessful application will be destroyed 24 months from the date of receiving the application. Full version of Data Privacy Notice available upon request.

title: Business Development Manager (Telecommunication Industry)-Hong Kong SAR
description:
Jobs Description：
 



 1\\\\\\\\. Business opportunity development
 



 •Proactively gain insight of Telecommunication industry in Hong Kong, identify key/potential customers, and be able to find key decision\\\\\\\\-maker and identify customers' needs.
 



 •Use customers' language to start conversations, gain customer trust, explore product and technology needs, and form solid business opportunities.
 



 •Regularly contact existing and potential customers to gain key information such as customers' business plans and budgets, supplier status, organizational structure, and technical environment.
 



 •Maintain customer relationships at all levels, and establish long\\\\\\\\-term business and technical relationships with customer CXO or CXO\\\\\\\\-D to obtain key support.
 



  





 2\\\\\\\\. Product and technology empowerment
 



 •Based on the understanding of the customer's industry and business background, help customers understand the technical value of Alibaba Cloud products such as Feitian Cloud Computing Operating System, Seven Big Pieces, AI/Intelligent Computing, and their differentiated competitive advantages relative to our Competitors, and convey Alibaba Cloud's role as the best partner for customers.
 



 •Independently explain Alibaba Cloud's standard product solutions to customers, or with the support of SA, clearly conveying the competitiveness of Alibaba Cloud's product solutions and the business value for the customers.
 



  





 3\\\\\\\\. Decision\\\\\\\\-making facilitation and business opportunity conversion
 



 •Through effective resource integration, facilitate customers to make better decisions, adopt and continue to use Alibaba Cloud products and technical solutions, and continue to create value for customers.
 



 •Through the use of a series of sales strategies such as communication influence and business negotiation, transform business opportunities to real projects, and achieve a win\\\\\\\\-win situation for customers.
 



 •Feedback problems encountered by customers that affect their experience, and help improve our products/solutions.
 



  





 4\\\\\\\\. Business support
 



 •Provide business support to customers throughout the entire life cycle, integrate resources from all parties to ensure project implementation.
 



  





 Qualification:
 



 • More than 5 years of To B sales or pre\\\\\\\\-sales related work experience, with experience in public cloud is preferred.
 



 • Have rich experience in selling software products, experience in PaaS products is preferred.
 



 • Independently interact with customer C\\\\\\\\-level to complete effective business and technical communication.
 



 • Understand customer business and digital transformation needs, diagnose customer technical problems in specific business scenarios, and provide competitive solutions.
 



 • Control the pace of negotiations, complete project negotiations independently, and achieve target results.
 



 • Understand the technological evolution in the product field, compare the similarities and differences in technical characteristics of similar products, and answer common questions from partners and customers about product technology development trends.
 



 • Accurately identify and classify customers' key stakeholders, and establish different communication strategies for different customers.
 



 • Take the lead in creating a friendly communication atmosphere, effectively listen to other people's opinions, and express your own opinions clearly.
 



 • Have good service awareness, be able to deal with customer problems till the end, effectively help customers solve problems, and ensure customer satisfaction.

title: Risk, Operational Risk, Associate, Hong Kong
description:
**Job Description**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals
   

  

**About Our Roles In Operationl Risk**
 Through measuring and managing operational risk across the firm, you will contribute to an effective and efficient allocation of risk capital, and enforce the risk appetite of the firm. In doing so you will provide commercial and strategic business risk insight to the firm and to our clients, including adjusting business practices to reduce inherent risk and increase ambient control. You will become a risk expert with in\\\\\\\\-depth knowledge in different businesses and all aspects of operational risk.
   

  

**Your Impact And Responsibilities**
 The Operational Risk Department, an independent risk management function as part of the Risk Division, is responsible for developing and implementing a standardized framework to identify, measure, and monitor operational risks across the firm.
   

  

 The role is for a junior professional with an interest in expanding on existing subject matter expertise in order to actively employ and strengthen the components of the firm’s operational risk management framework.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Facilitation of operational risk event collection, performing detailed reviews of events, tracking of remediation, conducting trend analysis and reporting
* Interaction with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Technology and the business in order to help identify enhancements through effective assessment and challenge of the business and technology processes and the Technology Control Infrastructure
* Working with Business Continuity Coordinators in all business and technology groups across the Asia region to ensure Divisional plans and assurance activities meet Firm and regulatory requirements
* Interaction with regulators in matters related to operational \\\\\\\\& technology risks as well as support for the firm’s Operational Risk Governance framework
* Exercising credible and effective challenge as a 2nd line of defense
* Ensuring operational risks arising from new products, activity, migrations, etc. are properly considered
* Remaining current on business drivers, regulatory and industry changes impacting the business, identifying new or emerging risks to which the business is exposed
* Providing clear and concise verbal and written recommendations and guidance to internal staff on Operational Risk matters
* Working with senior stakeholders across the Firm to further strengthen and develop the risk framework and its individual components
* Conducting training and raising awareness of the operational risk framework and business continuity program within the region
* Identifying, monitoring and analyzing risk measures
* Contributing to the advancement of operational risk methods and practices and the operational risk management framework


**Qualifications**
 This role requires an energetic self\\\\\\\\-starter who can liaise with teams across the Firm at several levels of management both regionally and globally, and may require interaction with external parties. Experience in businesses, products, technologies and control requirements is required together with strong interpersonal and analytical skills.
   

  

**Core Skills And Experience**
* Clear English communication skills (written and spoken)
* Strong understanding of risk management concepts and how Technology and Business controls, policies and procedures enable effective prevention, detection, and mitigation of risks
* Strong analytical, interpersonal, problem solving, organizational and time management skills
* Knowledge of Asia Financial Markets, products traded, and an understanding of the processes and business and technology flows in an Investment Bank
* Understanding of the regulatory environment and/or business continuity knowledge in developing or maintaining business continuity plans, business recovery site development and testing, and crisis management across Asia markets are an advantage
* Understanding of technology risks and controls including those applicable to Information Security, Cyber Security, and Application Development
* Good understanding of the regulatory environment in Asia
* Knowledge of, and experience with, Business Continuity and Technology Resiliency concepts and frameworks in order to drive the regional cross\\\\\\\\-divisional program which is part of the global Firmwide Business Continuity Program is advantageous
* Strong technical and quantitative aptitude to be able to understand and determine quantification of operational risks
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Able to present and communicate status and risks and technical details with impact and influence
* Ability to work in a fast paced environment
* Self\\\\\\\\-starter, able to work independently and proactively, with a proven track record of delivery
* Team oriented


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
   

  

 We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability\\\\\\\\-statement.html
   

  

 © The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2024\\\\\\\\. All rights reserved.
   

  

 Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Manager, Technical
description:
**Be part of an iconic story.**
 At Calvin Klein, we believe in fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture by celebrating different perspectives, backgrounds and beliefs to truly connect with our associates and consumers. Join us and have a meaningful impact on the world – and – endless opportunities to design your future. Immerse yourself in Calvin Klein here! (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok)
   

  

**Position Summary**
 All brands strategy, product development and innovation are led and driven by certain PVH affiliates in the US with respect to products under the Calvin Klein, and Tommy Hilfiger sold in NA, Asia and SA; and in the Netherlands with respect to products bearing the Tommy Hilfiger Europe, Calvin Klein Europe with respect and sold in the Asia region. The position in this job description helps the above mentioned PVH related parties meet their operating and strategic needs.
   

  

 Product focus is including but not limited to men’s and women’s underwear including bras, active wear, outerwear, sweater and loungewear.
   

  

 Strategically oversee the end\\\\\\\\-to\\\\\\\\-end technical development process across multiple product categories, ensuring consistency in fit, quality, and brand integrity. Build strong partnerships with Global Technical teams, Design, Merchandising, and Sourcing to align on seasonal direction, innovation, and executional excellence.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Strategically lead the technical development function, guiding a team of Garment Technicians and Assistant Managers to uphold fit excellence, SOP compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure consistency and clarity in fit comments and documentation across all systems (e.g., Centric), driving alignment with global standards and business objectives.
* Champion a proactive risk management culture by overseeing garment construction evaluations, quality assurance, and testing protocols, while driving innovative solutions to mitigate risk.
* Maintain accountability for design intent across all size bases and development stages, ensuring timely resolution of technical challenges in collaboration with Design and Sourcing and Raw Material teams.
* Oversee sample T\\\\\\\\&A management in partnership with Hub Sourcing and vendors, ensuring timely execution and issue resolution through strategic vendor engagement.
* Lead the annual review and evolution of SOPs, ensuring they reflect current business needs and industry best practices; drive implementation across internal and external teams.
* Direct vendor training and accreditation programs, ensuring technical readiness and consistent execution of PP and Fit Approvals across the supply base.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with vendors and cross\\\\\\\\-functional leaders to support business growth, innovation, and operational excellence.
* Drive cross\\\\\\\\-functional alignment through effective communication, technical leadership, and knowledge sharing across global teams.
* Lead and sponsor key initiatives and projects focused on process innovation, digital transformation, and continuous improvement in technical development.


 DECISION MAKING
   

  

* Strategically manage resource planning and work allocation across global technical teams and vendor networks, aligning with seasonal priorities and business objectives.
* Provide final authority on resolving high\\\\\\\\-impact technical issues, including pattern, grading, and yield discrepancies, ensuring solutions are scalable and aligned with brand strategy.
* Set and uphold standards for sample approvals, fit consistency, and quality benchmarks across categories, driving accountability and excellence across the team.
* Lead the evaluation and adoption of new technologies, tools, or methodologies that enhance product development, reduce risk, and support long\\\\\\\\-term brand growth.
* Influence cross\\\\\\\\-functional and leadership\\\\\\\\-level decisions by providing expert technical insights that balance innovation, cost, and consumer expectations.


 RESOURCEFULNESS/CREATIVITY
   

  

* Strategically drive the creation and governance of scalable technical libraries, fit standards, and digital assets that support long\\\\\\\\-term consistency, speed\\\\\\\\-to\\\\\\\\-market, and innovation.
* Inspire and empower teams to adopt a solution\\\\\\\\-oriented mindset, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and creative problem\\\\\\\\-solving across internal and external partners.
* Champion the integration of advanced digital tools and platforms to transform workflows, enhance data accuracy, and enable smarter decision\\\\\\\\-making across the product lifecycle.
* Lead cross\\\\\\\\-functional innovation projects that redefine best practices, improve operational agility, and future\\\\\\\\-proof the technical development function.


 ENVIRONMENT
   

  

* Lead by example in cultivating a high\\\\\\\\-performance, inclusive, and agile team environment that embraces change and innovation.
* Champion a culture of collaboration, empowerment, and continuous improvement across global teams and vendor networks.
* Create a supportive and resilient work environment that aligns with organizational values and drives team engagement, retention, and success.


 CORE VALUE
   

  

* Embrace PVH's core values: Individuality, Partnership, Passion, Integrity, and Accountability.


**Qualifications \\\\\\\\& Experience**
 Education \\\\\\\\& Experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Apparel Technology, Fashion Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10\\\\\\\\+ years of relevant experience in garment technical development, including at least 2–3 years in a leadership or managerial capacity.
* Deep expertise in fit development, patternmaking, grading, and quality assurance across multiple product categories.
* Demonstrated success in leading teams, driving cross\\\\\\\\-functional alignment, and influencing strategic decisions.
* Advanced proficiency in PLM systems, digital tools, and data\\\\\\\\-driven decision\\\\\\\\-making; experience with 3D fitting tools is a plus.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with a track record of driving innovation and operational excellence.


**Skills**
* Advance knowledge in garment technical development, including fit strategy, pattern innovation, grading logic, construction optimization, and quality assurance.
* Demonstrated leadership in managing and developing high\\\\\\\\-performing technical teams, with a focus on coaching, delegation, and succession planning.
* Deep product expertise in complex categories such as swimwear, lingerie, and performance wear, with a strong understanding of material behavior and construction challenges.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate creative vision into technically sound, commercially viable solutions.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of driving process improvements and operational efficiency.
* Influential communicator with the ability to lead cross\\\\\\\\-functional discussions, resolve conflicts, and align stakeholders at all levels.
* Advanced proficiency in digital tools including Lectra, PLM systems, and Microsoft Office Suite; experience with 3D fitting and digital product creation is highly desirable.
* Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate effectively across global teams and vendor networks


**About PVH**
 We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\\\\\\\\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\\\\\\\\+.
   

  

 One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \\\\\\\\& Diversity at PVH

 At Vita Green, we are all about creating a healthier, happier world, and we want you to be part of it! 
   





**About Vita Green Group** 




 Here at Vita Green, we are all about crafting something remarkable \\\\\\\\- be it careers, innovations, or impactful sales and marketing strategies! We believe every part of your journey can come together to make something truly exceptional.  
 



 Standing at the forefront of the health and wellness supplements industry, we are founded in Hong Kong and operating in multiple regional offices across the globe. With a diverse portfolio of established brands, including Dr. Choice, Naturo Vita, and Tea Chateau, our product offerings are constantly expanding, reaching markets worldwide and paving the way for a healthier future. 
   





**Position overview** 




 We are seeking a passionate and driven International Business Trainee, focusing on Cross\\\\\\\\-Border E\\\\\\\\-Commerce. This is a unique opportunity for Hong Kong talents to gain hands\\\\\\\\-on experience in international digital marketing, with a structured 18\\\\\\\\-month training program based in HK and ShenZhen. The trainee will be required to travel weekly between our Hong Kong and Shenzhen offices. Upon successful completion, high\\\\\\\\-performing trainees will be fast\\\\\\\\-tracked for promotion to Business Development Manager, leading overseas market expansion initiatives. 
   





 職位概覽
 



 我們誠邀充滿熱誠及積極進取的國際業務培訓生，專注於跨境電子商務。這是一個為香港人才提供的獨特機會，透過十八個月的結構化培訓計劃，獲得國際數碼市場推廣的實戰經驗。培訓生需每週往返香港與深圳辦公室。表現優異者將獲優先晉升為業務拓展經理，領導海外市場擴展項目。 
   

  





**What you ‘ll be doing** 



* Assist in planning and executing overseas social media advertising campaigns (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
* 協助策劃及執行海外社交媒體廣告活動（如 Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、YouTube 等）
* Assist in operating overseas marketplaces or e\\\\\\\\-Shops
* 協助營運海外網上市場或電子商店
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis in target regions (e.g., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America)
* 在目標地區（如東南亞、歐洲、北美）進行市場研究及競爭對手分析
* Collaborate with creative and content teams to develop engaging ad materials
* 與創意及內容團隊合作，製作吸引的廣告素材
* Monitor campaign performance and prepare regular reports with actionable insights
* 監察廣告活動表現，並撰寫具行動建議的定期報告
* Support localization of marketing content for different international markets
* 支援為不同國際市場本地化市場推廣內容
* Participate in cross\\\\\\\\-functional projects related to brand building and digital strategy
* 參與品牌建設及數碼策略相關的跨部門項目
* Coordinate with external agencies and influencers for campaign execution and partnerships
* 與外部代理及網紅協作推行廣告活動及建立合作關係
* Analyze audience behavior and trends to optimize ad targeting and messaging
* 分析受眾行為及趨勢，以優化廣告定位及訊息
* Stay updated on global digital marketing trends and platform updates
* 緊貼全球數碼市場推廣趨勢及平台更新
* Contribute ideas to improve brand visibility and engagement in overseas markets
* 提供意見以提升品牌在海外市場的曝光率及互動性
* Shadow senior business development leaders and participate in strategic planning sessions
* 跟隨高級業務拓展主管學習，並參與策略規劃會議
* Support business development activities including lead generation, partnership outreach, and market entry planning
* 支援業務拓展工作，包括潛在客戶開發、合作夥伴聯繫及市場進入規劃
* Travel weekly between Hong Kong and Shenzhen offices for cross\\\\\\\\-border collaboration and training
* 每週往返香港與深圳辦公室，進行跨境協作及培訓


**Requirements**

**Who we're looking for** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration (Information Systems), or other IT\\\\\\\\-related disciplines


* 持有電腦科學、資訊系統、工商管理（資訊系統）或其他 IT 相關學科的學士學位


* Strong interest in international marketing and digital advertising


* 對國際市場推廣及數碼廣告有濃厚興趣


* Familiarity with major social media platforms and advertising tools


* 熟悉主流社交媒體平台及廣告工具


* Good analytical and communication skills


* 具備良好的分析能力及溝通技巧


* Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus


* 英語流利；懂普通話者優先考慮


* Willingness to relocate to Shenzhen and travel weekly to Hong Kong


* 願意搬遷至深圳工作，並每週往返香港


* Ambition to grow into a leadership role in international business development


* 有志於發展成為國際業務拓展的領導角色


**Benefits**

**Why Join Us** 




*We value your professional and personal growth \\\\\\\\- fostering a positive work culture is our priority. Here, you'll find more than just a job, you'll discover a genuine opportunity to thrive.*



* Competitive monthly salary with annual performance bonus
* 具競爭力的月薪及年度表現獎金
* Comprehensive training and mentorship from experienced marketing professionals
* 由資深市場推廣專業人士提供全面培訓及指導
* Medical insurance and wellness support
* 醫療保險及健康支援
* Paid annual leave and statutory holidays
* 有薪年假及法定假期
* Career development opportunities within the company after the training period
* 培訓期後可於公司內部獲得事業發展機會
* Exposure to international markets and cross\\\\\\\\-border business operations
* 接觸國際市場及跨境業務運作
* Friendly and collaborative working environment
* 友善及協作的工作環境
* Fast\\\\\\\\-track promotion opportunity to Business Development Manager
* 可快速晉升為業務拓展經理



**And more!**




***Vita Green Health Products Co., Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***




***Join us in our mission to make a positive impact on wellness around the world!***

This role combines operational execution with reporting and process improvement, making it ideal for someone who thrives in both structured workflows and data\\\\\\\\-driven problem solving.
 



  





 You will handle client account requests, reporting, and data integrity checks, while also building Salesforce reports, Tableau dashboards, and process automations that improve efficiency. Working closely with the Senior Operations Manager, you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth client support and scaling operational excellence.
 



  






  




**Responsibilities:** 
* Operational Execution
* Process client account requests (account setup, withdrawal limits, fee adjustments, audits) within SLA
* Conduct regular Salesforce data integrity checks to ensure consistency across systems
* Maintain trackers and operational records, ensuring accuracy and compliance
* Prepare and distribute recurring institutional reports (e.g., Daily MM Report, client activity summaries)


* Reporting \\\\\\\\& Analytics
* Build and maintain Salesforce reports/dashboards to track client trading performance
* Support Tableau dashboard development for client activity and key operational metrics
* Monitor and analyze client trading volumes, rankings, and account performance
* Deliver ad\\\\\\\\-hoc reporting and insights to sales and account managers


* Process Improvement \\\\\\\\& Automation
* Maintain and optimize Slack workflows and other automation tools used by the team
* Identify workflow inefficiencies and propose solutions for automation and streamlining
* Document updated processes and contribute to team knowledge sharing


* Collaboration
* Partner with account managers, compliance, data, and finance teams to resolve operational requests
* Support the Senior Operations Manager on strategic projects and high\\\\\\\\-priority initiatives
* Act as a reliable point of contact for operational inquiries within the sales team



  




**Qualifications:** 
* 1–3 years of experience in operations, business analysis, or sales support (fintech/finance background preferred)
* Strong organizational skills, with ability to handle multiple tasks under tight deadlines
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with Salesforce reporting required
* Familiarity with Tableau (or other BI tools) strongly preferred
* Interest or experience with workflow automation (Slack workflows, macros, scripts)
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams



  




**What we offer:** 
* Opportunity to grow at the intersection of operations and analytics in the crypto industry
* Exposure to institutional trading operations, client support, and data\\\\\\\\-driven decision making
* A clear career development path toward mid\\\\\\\\-level operations management or business analytics
* A collaborative, fast\\\\\\\\-paced team environment where your work has immediate impact






  




  


 We may use artificial intelligence tools to analyze the content of your Resume/CV against the specific requirements for the position. The purpose is to support our recruitment team in reviewing applications more effectively. These tools assist our recruitment team in their evaluation of your application by providing recommendations, but they do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans who consider the insights generated by the tools along with other relevant information. If you would like more details about how your personal information is processed, please contact us.

title: Marketing Assistant
location: Wan Chai District, Hong Kong SAR
description:
**Job Description**
**Location: Wanchai, Hong Kong**
 In this office\\\\\\\\-based position you’ll experience a supportive approach to your wellbeing and continuous learning opportunities in our friendly and inclusive workplace. Find out more at computershare.com/flex.
   

  

**We give you a world of potential**
**About The USM Project**
 The government in Hong Kong is currently working towards the ‘dematerialisation’ of share certificates and the creation of an uncertificated securities market (USM). It’s a multi\\\\\\\\-year project and, once it’s complete, Computershare will be a regulated business for share registry services. This is a significant change for the Hong Kong market and will requires significant marketing and communications activity to a number of stakeholder groups including industry players, listed companies and their shareholders.
   

  

 A fantastic opportunity has arisen in our Marketing team.
   

  

**A role you will love**
**The Part Time Marketing Assistant** 
 provides essential support to the marketing and communication workstream of the USM project by handling marketing administration, assisting with campaign execution including public events, and contributing to market research and analysis. This position plays a vital role in ensuring smooth operations within the Marketing and Communications workstream.
   

  

 This is a
 **12\\\\\\\\-month contract** 
 role reporting to the Head of Marketing and Comms – USM; working closely with Business, Group Marketing, and Issuer Marketing teams.
   

  

**Some Other Key Accountabilities Will Include**
* Review and alignment of translation projects: follow up of translation and design projects within the Marketing and Communications workstream, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and adherence to brand guidelines across all marketing materials.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders: liaise with internal teams and external agencies to execute marketing events and activities for the USM project.
* Support for external marketing events: assist in coordination and on\\\\\\\\-the\\\\\\\\-ground execution of external marketing events such as industry conferences, client seminars, and educational trainings for retail investors.
* Project tracking: maintain up\\\\\\\\-to\\\\\\\\-date records of approved marketing materials in intranet.
* External agency follow\\\\\\\\-up: handle and track payment process to external agencies, ensuring timely processing in accordance with internal finance procedures.
* Market research: conduct market research to support campaign strategy and execution. This includes gathering and analysing market data, identifying industry trends, and providing actionable insights to help inform decision\\\\\\\\-making within the marketing and communications workstream.


**What will you bring to the role?**
 To be successful in this role, you must have excellent marketing knowledge, as well as problem solving and interpersonal skills.
   

  

**Some Other Key Skills Required For The Role**
* Past experience of working in marketing functions.
* Project management skills: proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines are met and deliverables align with brand standards.
* Attention to detail: demonstrated accuracy in reviewing, proofreading, and aligning marketing materials, particularly translations and design assets.
* Stakeholder collaboration: strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience liaising across business units and engaging external agencies to deliver successful events and campaigns.
* Event coordination: hands\\\\\\\\-on experience supporting, and executing marketing events, including conferences, seminars, and training sessions.
* Adaptability \\\\\\\\& initiative: capacity to respond to shifting priorities and increased demand for marketing support, demonstrating resourcefulness under pressure.
* Excellent English, Cantonese and Mandarin skills.


**Rewards designed for you**
**Flexible work** 
 to help you find the best balance between work and lifestyle.
   

  

**Health and wellbeing** 
 rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family.
   

  

**Invest in our business** 
 by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you’ll receive a company contribution as well.
   

  

**Extra rewards** 
 ranging from recognition awards and team get togethers to helping you invest in your future.
   

  

**And more.** 
 Ours is a welcoming and close\\\\\\\\-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub.
   

  

**About Us**
**A company to be proud of**
 We're a global leader in financial administration with over 12,000 employees across more than 22 different countries. At Computershare, it’s more than just a job, our open and inclusive culture means that we will help you to grow, to move forward and make the most of our world of opportunities.
   

  

**Fairness and culture**
 We're dedicated to providing you with the opportunity to succeed on your own merits, starting from the application process and continuing throughout your career with us. Our goal is to create an environment where everyone feels valued, to remove barriers and obstacles and ensure equal opportunities for all. For support with accommodations or adjustments during our recruitment process please visit computershare.com/access for further information.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Shared Services teams support all of our business lines behind the scenes. Across the world, we have a range of specialisms that ensure the delivery of our business priorities. These include Technology, Information Security, Finance, Risk, Audit, Governance, Marketing and Communications as well as our People team. Join our strategic team and help us look after everything from creating an amazing end to end employee journey to keeping our systems safe. You'll be looking after our people, our clients and their customers, whilst maintaining our exceptional standards around the globe.

**Summary** 




 This Research role will conduct regional, global macroeconomic and geopolitical analysis, based in Hong Kong.
 



  





 Eligible candidates should be completing their degree requirements and are available to start working by Dec 2025\\\\\\\\. Trainee contract is one year to begin with and renewable for up to two years in total.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Based in Hong Kong, the research trainee conducts research on economic, political and geopolitical developments and their impact on Asian economy and markets:
 


* Monitor and track macro, political and geopolitical developments across key Asian economies
* Develop risk assessments, scenario forecasts and make use of statistical analysis to interpret how geopolitics influence macroeconomic indicators, trade flows and financial markets in Asia
* Critically evaluate information and produce briefings in a professional and concise manner for clients as well as internal stakeholders including senior management
* Collaborate with economists and market strategists to provide analysis relating to global political developments
* Immerse in Asia’s rich culture to synthesize on\\\\\\\\-the\\\\\\\\-ground color to geopolitical analysis
* Contribute to published research reports



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor / Master degree in Political Science, International Relations, Economics or relevant fields with less than 12 months' full\\\\\\\\-time experiences
* Previous experience in a related analytical role in macro research, policy consulting, government, or think tank would be an advantage
* Curious, adaptable and eager to develop geopolitical expertise in Asia’s complex environment
* Strong team player, hardworking with a deep sense of commitment and responsibility
* Ability to multi\\\\\\\\-task and meet tight deadlines under a fast\\\\\\\\-moving work environment
* Excellent writing and communication skills, attentive to details
* Deep interest and understanding of global political landscape with good knowledge of US politics
* Fluent in English; French is an advantage



  





 In accordance with the Mandatory Reference Checking (MRC) Scheme implemented by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA), a successful candidate for an In\\\\\\\\-Scope Position who has held a position with an In\\\\\\\\-Scope Institution in the past 7 years will be subject to a mandatory reference check. For more details, please refer to Mandatory Reference Checking Scheme Phase 2 \\\\\\\\| The Hong Kong Association of Banks.
 



  





**Application Method** 




 Please apply for this role on our Career Website.

title: Associate, Global Family Offices, Asia Pacific
description:
**Position Overview**
 Apollo is seeking an Associate to join our Global Family Office (GFO) coverage team in our Hong Kong office. This newly created role will ideally suit a high performing junior investment banker or alternatives sales / wealth management executive looking to support our coverage efforts of leading Family Offices \\\\\\\\& Businesses across Asia Pacific (APAC). Our offices in APAC span 6 key countries / locations: Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Sydney, Mumbai, and Seoul.
   

  

 GFO sits within GWMS, a vertically integrated sales channel within Apollo’s broader Client \\\\\\\\& Product Solutions (CPS) ecosystem designed to provide individuals and their advisors access to a growing range of wealth management solutions across yield, hybrid, equity, and retirement services that go beyond the public markets. The individual will partner closely with the GFO \\\\\\\\& GWMS team to drive coverage of leading Family Offices \\\\\\\\& Businesses in the region, execute regional sales strategy, working in close partnership with the APAC Head of Global Wealth Management and other regional leaders, while also maintaining connectivity with counterparts across the US and EMEA on joint initiatives.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Alongside the head of APAC GFO, develop and cultivate relationships across Family Offices \\\\\\\\& Businesses by being a thought partner, capital solutions provider and custodian to the wealthiest families in the region.
* Prepare presentation materials covering capital formation, co\\\\\\\\-investments, capital solutions (M\\\\\\\\&A, financing) and strategic investments.
* Manage firm data requests, maintain investor sales pipeline, and own Salesforce activity for the GFO team.
* Provide timely support to GFOs for Apollo products.
* Assist team leadership with presentation materials, memos, and internal reporting request.
* Providing excellent and professional client service, always representing Apollo’s core values.


**Partnering Closely With**
* Head of APAC Global Wealth Management, Global Head of Family Office, and Head of EMEA Family Office to manage relationships with leading Family Offices \\\\\\\\& Businesses in APAC.
* Broader Asia capital formation teams on fundraise strategy and execution in the region.
* APO investment teams to provide a full solutions approach to families and family businesses across both their investing and financing needs.


**Qualifications \\\\\\\\& Experience**
* 2\\\\\\\\-5 years’ experience in investment banking, wealth management, or family offices in Singapore or Hong Kong
* Solid corporate finance (M\\\\\\\\&A, financing), financial product knowledge, experience in alternatives is a plus
* Great attention to detail, responsible person with strong work ethic
* Be able to stretch into any area and take ownership of delegated tasks to support team’s goals
* Interest in client facing role with potential to becoming coverage officer, understand collaboration in a global firm
* A multi\\\\\\\\-tasker that can prioritize and manage their time effectively
* Team player, culture fit for Apollo; Maintain high level of professionalism and integrity
* Experienced working in an international organization and willingness to be flexible with hours as part of a global firm
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Salesforce/CRM.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication.
* Additional Asian languages preferred: Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Bahasa.


**About Apollo**
 Apollo is a high\\\\\\\\-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk\\\\\\\\-reward spectrum from investment grade to private equity with a focus on three investing strategies: yield, hybrid, and equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of June 30, 2025, Apollo had approximately $840 billion of assets under management. To learn more, please visit www.apollo.com.
   

  

**OUR PURPOSE AND CORE VALUES**
 Our Clients Rely On Our Investment Acumen To Help Secure Their Future. We Must Never Lose Our Focus And Determination To Be The Best Investors And Most Trusted Partners On Their Behalf. We Strive To Be
   

  

 The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals.
   

  

 The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.
   

  

 A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.
   

  

 We are building a unique firm of extraordinary colleagues who:
   

  

* Outperform Expectations
* Challenge Convention
* Champion Opportunity
* Lead Responsibly
* Drive Collaboration


 As One Apollo team, we believe that doing great work and having fun go hand in hand, and we are proud of what we can achieve together.
   

  

**Our Benefits**
 Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family. Please reach out to your Human Capital Business Partner for more detailed information on specific benefits.
   

  

*Apollo provides equal employment opportunities regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, veteran status, gender/sex or sexual orientation, or any other criterion or circumstance protected by applicable law, ordinance, or regulation. The above criteria are intended to be used as a guide only – candidates who do not meet all the above criteria may still be considered if they are deemed to have relevant experience/ equivalent levels of skill or knowledge to fulfil the requirements of the role. Any job offer will be conditional upon and subject to satisfactory reference and background screening checks, all necessary corporate and regulatory approvals or certifications as required from time to time, and entering into definitive contractual documentation satisfactory to Apollo.*
 Come to Apollo and join a community of extraordinary people who are committed to a culture of excellence and collaboration in everything that we do. We invest in our people for the long term and are committed to supporting their development at every stage of their career.

description:
**The Department**

 The Club's Football Betting business is one of the largest bookmaking operations in the world with annual Turnover and Gross Margin in excess of HK$140B and HK$18B respectively. Set up in 2003, the Football Trading team has evolved to cover fixed odds racing operations, data analysis, sports integrity, system and product development, as well as providing and training these services overseas.
   

  

 Unique opportunities are here for you if you want to:
   

  

* Understand the operations of the global betting industry
* Enjoy the experience of working in a rapidly expanding sports business
* Work with a dynamic team with diverse background and culture
* Develop your skills working with the market leader in sports trading


**The Job**
 You will:
   

  

- Formulate and communicates odds for events by:

* compiling odds for events
* communicating odds and information


- Maximise profitability of event betting and monitors customer activity in regard to profitability by:

* identifying and executing prices changes
* analysing profitability of event betting
* monitoring customer performance for immediate trends and season profitability
* reporting on market and/or product profitability and recommend action to improve the business


- Conduct customer analysis, researches, and manage projects by:

* analysing customer data to identify trends and insights, and categorizing customers into different types
* conducting comprehensive research to better understand industry shifts, customer preferences, and product profitability
* executing projects aimed at addressing specific business questions or challenges
* reporting findings and making recommendations to enhance customer engagement and business strategies
* Ensure compliance with Responsible Gambling Policy and all stipulated legal requirements pertaining to wagering, thereby protecting the integrity of the Club’s businesses
* Undertake other duties as assigned by supervisor

 You should have:
   

  

* Bachelor degree with strong numerical and analytical skills
* Relevant experience in the sports betting industry with prior exposure to sports trading management and fixed\\\\\\\\-odds markets compilation is preferred
* Computer literacy and capability in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel
* Extensive knowledge of major sports and preferably good working knowledge of them
* Knowledgeable about major sports and able to explain odds
* Ability to stay calm and concentrate for long periods of time under pressure
* Flexibility and ability to work the hours required including nights and weekends


**Fresh graduates will be considered**
 Comprehensive training in odds compilation and risk management will be provided. A flexible approach to working hours is required for the position as working during evenings, weekends and public holidays is necessary to meet the challenges of the job.
   

  

**Terms of Employment**
 The level of appointment will be commensurate with qualification and experience.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please send your resume, complete with expected salary and job reference by clicking the Apply Now button.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with the Club's notice to employees and prospective employees relating to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance. A copy of which will be provided immediately upon request.
